# SnakeWise

> SnakeWise is a free, original educational website about snakes for curious beginners and enthusiasts. It explains snake anatomy, movement, venom and constriction, notable species, habitats, common myths, safety around wild snakes and pet snake basics, and offers a region-by-region guide to telling venomous snakes from harmless lookalikes. SnakeWise is a brand owned and operated by Joshua Israel Ventures LLC, which does all SnakeWise business.

The content is general education, not medical advice or a field identification key.

## Guides
- [Snake anatomy](https://snakewise.org/anatomy.html): skeleton, scales and shedding, senses, jaws and organs
- [How snakes move](https://snakewise.org/movement.html): lateral undulation, concertina, rectilinear, sidewinding and gliding
- [Venom vs constriction](https://snakewise.org/venom-constriction.html): how snakes subdue prey, fang types, venomous vs poisonous
- [Notable snake species](https://snakewise.org/species.html): comparison table and profiles of 12 remarkable species
- [Snake habitats](https://snakewise.org/habitats.html): where snakes live, from rainforests and deserts to oceans
- [Snake myths vs facts](https://snakewise.org/myths.html): common misconceptions corrected
- [Safety around wild snakes](https://snakewise.org/safety.html): prevention, encounters and snakebite first-aid do's and don'ts
- [Snakes as pets](https://snakewise.org/pets.html): beginner species, enclosure, heat, feeding and health basics
- [Snake glossary](https://snakewise.org/glossary.html): definitions of common snake terms

## Blog
- [SnakeWise blog](https://snakewise.org/blog/): species profiles and fact articles with cited, verified sources
- [Paradise flying snake: how a snake with no wings glides](https://snakewise.org/blog/paradise-flying-snake.html): range, size, diet, and how Chrysopelea paradisi jumps, flattens and undulates to glide (2026-10-08)

## Tools
- [Venomous or not? ID guide by region](https://snakewise.org/venomous-or-not.html): venomous snakes and harmless lookalikes in North America, UK and Europe, Australia, South Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America
  - Region sections: [North America](https://snakewise.org/venomous-or-not.html#north-america), [UK & Europe](https://snakewise.org/venomous-or-not.html#uk-europe), [Australia](https://snakewise.org/venomous-or-not.html#australia), [South Asia](https://snakewise.org/venomous-or-not.html#south-asia), [Sub-Saharan Africa](https://snakewise.org/venomous-or-not.html#africa), [Central & South America](https://snakewise.org/venomous-or-not.html#latin-america); plus a snake identification FAQ

## For teachers and researchers
- [SnakeWise for teachers](https://snakewise.org/teachers/): free K-12 snake teaching resources, no sign-up
- [Printable snake fact sheet](https://snakewise.org/teachers/snake-fact-sheet.html): grades 3-5
- [Snake adaptations worksheet](https://snakewise.org/teachers/snake-adaptations-worksheet.html): grades 3-5, NGSS 4-LS1-1 and 3-LS4-3
- [Answer keys](https://snakewise.org/teachers/answer-keys.html)
- [Snake vocabulary list](https://snakewise.org/teachers/vocabulary.html)
- [Snake lesson plan ideas](https://snakewise.org/teachers/lesson-ideas.html): K-12, aligned to NGSS K-LS1-1, 3-LS4-3, 4-LS1-1, 4-LS1-2, MS-LS4-4, HS-LS4-4
- [Research papers for students and researchers](https://snakewise.org/research/): peer-reviewed papers with verified DOIs

## Games
- [SnakeWise games](https://snakewise.org/games/): hub of free, original snake games that teach real facts
- [Lookalike Lab](https://snakewise.org/games/lookalike-lab/): venomous or harmless quiz using clues from the ID guide (learning only, not safety advice)
- [Scale Snap](https://snakewise.org/games/scale-snap/): memory match of snake markings, each pair revealing which species wears it
- [Shed Shuffle](https://snakewise.org/games/shed-shuffle/): tile-swap picture puzzle about how snakes shed their skin
